name: MMTEB
description: MMTEB (Massive Multilingual Text Embedding Benchmark) is a large-scale, community-driven benchmark covering over 500 evaluation tasks across 250+ languages. It evaluates text embedding models on diverse tasks including instruction following, long-document retrieval, and code retrieval, providing a comprehensive multilingual evaluation suite.
typical_sota_score: varies by task; roughly 70–95% for leading multilingual embedding models
reputation: A widely used multilingual embedding benchmark that has quickly become a standard large-scale evaluation suite for text embedding models across many languages and tasks.
notes: Includes novel tasks and optimizations to reduce computational cost while preserving model ranking.
